games.name: Never Have I Ever
games.description: Players take turns saying something they have never done. Works for 2+ players.

cards.text: Never have I ever stayed up all night binge-watching a show.
Never have I ever ghosted someone.
Never have I ever cried during a movie.
Never have I ever peed in a pool.
Never have I ever stolen something (even something small).
Never have I ever lied about my age.
Never have I ever had a huge embarrassing public fail.
Never have I ever eaten food that fell on the floor.
Never have I ever laughed so hard I forgot what I was saying.

instructionsByMode.couples: Take turns reading a statement. Each player says whether they have done it.
instructionsByMode.friends: Take turns reading a statement. Each player says whether they have done it.
instructionsByMode.group: Take turns reading a statement. Players who have done it raise a hand or score a point.

games.name: Who's Most Likely To
games.description: Everyone points at who they think is most likely. Adaptable for 2 players by discussion.

cards.text: Who's most likely to survive a zombie apocalypse?
Who's most likely to become famous?
Who's most likely to forget their own birthday?
Who's most likely to get lost in their own city?
Who's most likely to win the lottery and lose the ticket?
Who is most likely to remember everyone’s favorite food?
Who is most likely to start a kitchen dance party?
Who is most likely to turn a missed train into an adventure?
Who is most likely to remember a name after one introduction?
Who is most likely to make a stranger feel welcome?
Who is most likely to invent a game using three random objects?
Who is most likely to give the best unexpected pep talk?
Who is most likely to organize a surprise without spoiling it?
Who is most likely to lead an impromptu dance lesson?
Who is most likely to make everyone laugh without saying a word?

instructionsByMode.couples: Choose which of the two of you best fits the prompt, then explain your choice.
instructionsByMode.friends: Choose which of the two of you best fits the prompt, then explain your choice.
instructionsByMode.group: Read the prompt and vote for a player. Discuss the result, then pass the turn.

games.name: Would You Rather
games.description: Choose one option. Great debate starter. Excellent for 2 players.

cards.text: Would you rather have unlimited money or unlimited free time?
Would you rather be able to fly or be invisible?
Would you rather always be 10 minutes late or 20 minutes early?
Would you rather never use social media again or never watch TV/movies again?

instructionsByMode.couples: Both players choose an option and explain why.
instructionsByMode.friends: Both players choose an option and explain why.
instructionsByMode.group: Each player chooses an option; compare choices before the next card.

notes: Player limits are editorial game limits, not networking or device limits.
Two friends and a romantic couple are separate modes; groups may contain multiple couples.
supportedModes and player limits determine eligibility; recommendedModes only affects ordering.
No pricing is specified in this catalog.

Clean-only public subset of catalog 3.2, made for the public LOKA Pay repo at Hacklanta II: only cards tagged clean are kept; cards tagged dirty or drinking and the three games named for drinking or explicit content were removed, and sentences about drinking were removed from game descriptions. Kept card ids and texts are unchanged.

filteredDeck.tagPolicy: Clean-only public subset: every card is tagged clean and needs no age, consent or drinking gate.

playModes.label: Group
playModes.description: Three or more players, including friends or multiple couples.

gameFilters: Player count must be inside the selected play mode and game minPlayers/maxPlayers ranges.
The selected mode must appear in game.supportedModes.
Only show games with at least one card remaining after all card filters.
cardFilters: The selected mode must appear in card.supportedModes.
Player count must be inside card.minPlayers/maxPlayers.
Card intensity must appear in the selected intensities.
Exclude requiresConsent cards unless allowConsentDares is true.
selectionRules.recommendationRule: Use recommendedModes to sort eligible games/cards, never to override eligibility.
selectionRules.displayRule: Show game name, playerCountLabel, description, eligible card count and instructionsByMode for the selected mode.
selectionRules.repeatRule: Track played card IDs for this session. Draw without replacement; when exhausted, offer replay or a different game.
selectionRules.emptyResultRule: Show that no cards match and let players change their filters or choose another game.
